subject: Post-call exec recap: HelixPharma - next steps & procurement path
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Moore <daniel.moore@helixpharma.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@helixpharma.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call exec recap: HelixPharma - next steps & procurement path

Hi Daniel / Priya —

Thanks again for your time this afternoon. Quick executive-level recap from our discussion and proposed next steps so we have alignment going into procurement: 

Summary of pain points / goals:
- Current LLM vendor has inconsistent latency at peak which is impacting customer-facing workflows (~600–800ms p95 for typical 1k token workloads).
- Cost per useful token is high at scale; team is focused on predictable unit economics for production traffic.
- Security/compliance is a hard requirement (audit logs, KMS, SOC2 evidence) for any private deployment.
- Success metrics: reduce p95 latency to <300ms for key flows, lower per-token cost by ~30% through batching/quantization, and meet audit evidence requirements for procurement.

Risks / open items we discussed:
- Procurement & legal timeline (you mentioned a centralized procurement review + security questionnaire).
- Integration support for the 3rd-party data connectors used by your analytics team.

Proposed next steps:
1) Redwood provides an executive recap + procurement packet (attached) and SOC2/ISO evidence.
2) Schedule a 30–45m procurement & legal sync next week to confirm review path and timeline (please confirm who from procurement/legal should join).
3) Pilot proposal: 6-week POC (Dedicated or Private), low-risk data handling, success metrics and exit criteria defined (Redwood will provide SOW & pilot pricing).

If this captures things correctly, can you confirm: 1) procurement contact(s) and expected decision timeline, and 2) whether a Private deployment is a requirement for the pilot or if Dedicated with strict network controls is acceptable for the pilot phase?

Attachments: [Attachment: Redwood-Helix-Exec-Recap.pdf (3 pages)]

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the procurement packet and a proposed calendar for next week once I get the procurement contact.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
https://redwoodinference.com

From: Daniel Moore <daniel.moore@helixpharma.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@helixpharma.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call exec recap: HelixPharma - next steps & procurement path

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. A few quick clarifications: 

- Procurement path: we run all vendor contracts through Central Procurement (James Park) + Legal (contract redlines). Typical timeline is 4–6 weeks post-RFP/packet for standard SaaS; Private/on-prem solutions can add time.
- Compliance evidence: please include SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 summary, and any penetration test reports you can share.
- Pilot: we’re open to a Dedicated pilot provided it meets our encryption and audit logging requirements. Private deployment is preferred for production, but not strictly required for an initial POC.

Can you also provide a pricing sheet for a 6-week pilot and t-shirt estimates for required GPU capacity? I’ve attached our security questionnaire template for reference — if you could populate the sections relevant to audit logs/encryption that would speed review.

Thanks — I’ll loop James and Legal once we have the packet.

Daniel
VP, Product & Data Strategy | HelixPharma
daniel.moore@helixpharma.com | +1 (617) 555-0199

[Attachment: SOC2-evidence-request.xlsx (Helix security questionnaire)]

Daniel — great to meet you (virtually). I’m Laura on the customer success / solutions side and will own the pilot delivery + SOW. A few concrete items to move forward quickly: 

1) Pilot scope & timeline: 6-week pilot, objectives to validate latency, cost savings from batching & quantization, and audit logging. We propose:
   - Week 0: onboarding & environment setup (dedicated pool)
   - Weeks 1–4: integration & validation with your sample workflows
   - Weeks 5–6: optimization, executive review, and success evaluation

2) Pricing & capacity: for the pilot we can offer a pilot discount (pilot pricing sheet linked below). Rough estimate: 2 x A100-equivalent GPU capacity sustained for baseline tests; we’ll refine after we see traffic patterns.

3) Compliance: attached procurement packet includes SOC2 summary, encryption approach (KMS + HSM options), audit log samples, and a completed version of Helix’s questionnaire on the audit/logging sections.

4) Procurement packet & next steps: I’ve uploaded the SOW & pricing pack here: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/helix/exec-recap. We can produce a DocuSign-ready SOW once procurement confirms the internal approvers.

I’ll schedule a 30m procurement sync for next week — Marissa, could you confirm James Park (procurement) and the preferred time slots?

Attachments: [Attachment: Helix-Procurement-Packet.pdf (8 pages)]

Best,

Laura Bennett
Director, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com | +1 (650) 555-0231
